summary: 8 followers, 6 posts, 539 views/30 days. Two reels got 600-783 views via collabs but 64-75% skip rates and 7-11s avg watch. Zero Instagram DMs. Data too thin to judge chatbot content; only website posts exist.
guidance:
- Hook style to try next: Problem-Agitate-Solve (e.g., "11 PM WhatsApp flood → lost bookings → bot handles it")
- Avoid repeating "Rs 1499, 24 hrs" phrasing; it's used in 3/6 posts
- High skip rates (64-75%) mean first 3 seconds fail — open with visual proof, not talking head
- Share rate 51% on clock reel came from collab, not content; don't rely on collabs for reach
- Posts must show real dev work: screen recordings, code snippets, live bot replies — never read like an ad

instructions.research: Find 3 common pain points of Himachal hotels/cafes that a chatbot solves (missed late-night bookings, language queries, repeat FAQs). Search "Himachal hotel WhatsApp booking" and note exact phrases owners use.
instructions.analysis: Compare the two reels' retention curves: both show steep initial drop then flat. The clock reel's 51% share rate came from collab tags, not organic interest. Note that cafe preview had 0.4% share rate despite higher views.
instructions.writer: Draft a 90-sec reel script for AI chatbot: Hook (0-3s): "Your WhatsApp blows up at 11 PM. You're asleep. This bot replies, books rooms, upsells dinner." Demo (3-30s): screen record bot handling a real hotel query. Proof (30-60s): show dashboard with 3 auto-bookings. CTA (60-90s): "Setup in 2 days. DM 'BOT' for free audit."
instructions.image: Create carousel: Slide 1 — "3 messages you lose while sleeping" with blurred hotel WhatsApp screenshots. Slide 2 — chatbot handling each in Hindi/English. Slide 3 — "Goes live in 48 hrs. DM 'BOT'." Use your brand colors, no stock photos.
instructions.video: Shoot 30-sec screen recording of your chatbot demo on a local hotel site (anonymized). Add captions: "User asks: 'Room available 20 Oct?' → Bot checks calendar → Confirms → Sends payment link." Use trending audio at 10% volume.

manual_tips: Comment on 5 posts from Himachal hotel/cafe owners (not competitors) with genuine observations: "Love the mountain view from your balcony! Noticed your website doesn't show room availability live — happy to share a 2-min Loom of how a bot could auto-reply bookings."
Reply to all 16 comments on the '24 clock' reel with personalized answers (not emojis). Example: "Thanks! The 24-hr build uses a custom CMS — happy to show the backend if useful."
Message past WhatsApp enquiries (if any) offering a free 15-min chatbot audit: "Saw you enquired about a website. Added a chatbot demo for your cafe — want a quick screen share?"
